records.title: Lacrosse — Onondaga accounts of the Medicine Game

time.original: Origin not assigned a calendar date
time.method: Community explanation of tradition; no dated origin supplied.
time.interpretation: The account explains a continuing tradition without fixing its first calendar year. It is not projected onto every ancient village or every Indigenous ball game. Modern forms and participation can differ.

claims.text: Onondaga describes lacrosse as a sacred game associated with healing, community and handmade wooden sticks. This is a community account of meaning, not an archaeological invention date.
claims.explanation: The account explains a continuing tradition without fixing its first calendar year. It is not projected onto every ancient village or every Indigenous ball game. Modern forms and participation can differ.
